blocks.x: He was like this even before -- this did not start in the Army.

Yeah, he was always like that. He was always like that. And he used to tell me some stories about his father and he couldn't read and his sister played tenor. See, when I first met him, his sister played tenor and he played alto and Lee played drums. And the name of the act was Pap, Sis and Bub. They played Sherman and he was playing alto then. And that's during the time -- this must be close -- I can't pinpoint it, but it was during the time that I heard the Whiteman band and I met Bix and all of them.
